entities.name: Cross-Border Telehealth Platform
entities.description: A unified cross-border telehealth SaaS platform providing video consultations, e-prescriptions, and an AI symptom checker for patients in the EU and US, enforcing strict regional data residency and compliance using isolated cloud deployments.

entities.name: Patients & Licensed Clinicians
entities.description: Primary human users interacting via Web and Mobile Apps for video consultations, e-prescriptions, and symptom checking.

entities.name: Pharmacies & Regional Health Authorities/Payers
entities.description: External systems handling prescriptions, claims, and reimbursement.

entities.name: AI Triage Model Provider
entities.description: GCP Vertex AI managing symptom-checking inference.

entities.name: Web & Mobile Apps
entities.description: Client-facing applications for patients and clinicians.

entities.name: API Gateway & BFF
entities.description: External traffic routing, TLS termination, and backend-for-frontend logic.

entities.name: Core Telehealth Service
entities.description: Implements the core telehealth service business logic.

entities.name: AI Triage Service
entities.description: Powers the AI Triage Service for local PHI/PII sanitization and model interaction.

entities.name: Consent & Audit Ledger
entities.description: Serves as the Consent & Audit Ledger, secured via Customer-Managed Encryption Keys (CMEK) via Cloud KMS.

entities.name: E-Prescription Dispatcher
entities.description: Dispatches e-prescriptions to regional pharmacies and health authorities.

interfaces.description: Connect via WebRTC for video and HTTPS for APIs
Integrates using REST and HL7 FHIR protocols
Authenticates users via regional IAM systems
Interacts with UI for video consultations, e-prescriptions, and symptom checking
Sends client requests and API calls
Reads and writes audit logs and consent records

naming_conventions: Use descriptive plural names for human actor roles (e.g., 'Patients & Licensed Clinicians')
Use descriptive functional names for external systems (e.g., 'AI Triage Model Provider')
